subject.title: [Feature]: openclaw notify — admin-scoped push to connected UI sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core shell-facing admin notification RPC/event and Control UI in-app notification surface, or should this request be folded into broader notification-system design?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but it creates new product, Gateway protocol, and security semantics that code inspection cannot choose safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add a core notification contract
options.body: Create a narrow admin-scoped CLI/Gateway/UI notification path with explicit auth, targeting, payload, rate-limit, and documentation requirements.

options.title: Fold into broader WebUI notifications
options.body: Keep this issue linked to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/20237 and design the shell/admin trigger as part of that broader toast/notification system.

options.title: Keep notifications outside core
options.body: Decline a core command and direct external tools toward plugins, hooks, Web Push, or channel-specific notification paths once the needed extension API is explicit.

recommendation.title: Add a core notification contract
recommendation.body: Create a narrow admin-scoped CLI/Gateway/UI notification path with explicit auth, targeting, payload, rate-limit, and documentation requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: The current main snapshot and Gateway/CLI/UI boundary history point to this person as the best available routing owner for a cross-surface product/security decision.
